WITH completed AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_delivered_customer_date,
    o.order_estimated_delivery_date
  FROM orders.orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
),
window_share AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*), 4) AS value,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM completed
  WHERE order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-06-04'
),
baseline_share AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*), 4) AS value,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM completed
  WHERE order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-21'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-05-28'
)
SELECT
  ws.value AS value,
  bs.value AS baseline,
  ws.n AS window_n,
  bs.n AS baseline_n
FROM window_share ws, baseline_share bs;
